I told Ilse in their DM that their dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is Bay 30. They told me that on 14 Oct.

I got the answer from their own DM with me, not from the saved note. Looking up the private note I saved on 14 Oct returned nothing. GBrain says that connections like this one can only read facts saved as visible to everyone, which probably explains it. So saving things privately isn't a reliable way to remember them here. The DM history works because Ilse can see it too, and nothing else I checked was in a place Ilse can't see.
